lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of vertically aligned columns of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit. These clusters form a repeating grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank, with approximately 4-5 spots visible per column in the primary field of view.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observed intersecting with the high-luminance blobs, creating a structured nodal grid across the anterior and mid-flank regions.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the superior surface and a shadowed inferior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the pectoral fin and the ventral head region.
